description: This file contains a PHP class 'Information' which is a controller extending OpenCart's engine controller. It manages the display and saving of a module configuration page in the OpenCart admin interface. The class includes methods for rendering the module settings page and handling updates to the configuration.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for managing the 'Information' module in OpenCart's admin extension module namespace. Responsible for displaying and saving module configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the module settings page, including setting breadcrumbs, page title, headers, footers, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the AJAX request to save module configuration settings, including permission checks and returning a JSON response.
